identity_invariants: Preserve one project's spatial DNA, business category, functional zoning, circulation, operating anchors and service logic across the set.
Keep architecture, doors, windows, material system, furniture identity and spatial relationships consistent across viewpoints.
Use different areas, viewpoints and shot scales without mixing in an unrelated project.
Do not alter an existing design unless the Operator explicitly enables a design-upgrade mode.
specialized_hard_blocks: Unrelated project mixed into one set
Over-HDR, CGI drift or physically implausible material, light, shadow or reflection
specialized_quality_checks: Door, window, furniture and circulation continuity
Single-page QA and contact-sheet Group QA
consistency_requirements: Meaningful differences in area, camera axis, viewpoint and shot scale
Historic versions remain bound to their original Pack and Profile versions
fallback_strategies: Use an editorial diagram when no authorized project photography exists.
recommended_questions: Is this a real project, a concept, or a generated scene?
prohibited_claims_or_representations: Generated scene presented as completed construction
known_limitations: Generated scenes are not construction evidence.
